name: Foresight
description: A private Gemini journal for reflection, connected decisions, outcome learning and a factual personal knowledge graph.

/users/{uid}/decisions/{id}.links: optional journalId and selected evidence IDs

/users/{uid}/interactions/{id}.fields: prompt, response, mode, tags and multi-turn history

knowledgeGraph.storage: none; derived in the browser from owner-readable records

privacyOperations.export: authenticated Markdown or JSON generation scoped to the verified UID
privacyOperations.deleteAllStoredData: authenticated recursive deletion under /users/{uid}; Firebase Authentication account is preserved
